claims.claim: The item is a solar panel / solar energy solution.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a large rectangular solar panel with a grid of photovoltaic cells and a dark frame.

risks.risk: Rated wattage or power output is unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the panel's specification label or nameplate.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unrated panel of that size at the lowest output tier.

risks.risk: Age and usage history are unknown.
risks.proof: Photo of the manufacture date sticker or original purchase receipt.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an aged panel with degraded output.

risks.proof: Warranty card or screenshot showing active warranty verification.

risks.risk: Hidden physical defects such as cracks, delamination, or hot spots.
risks.proof: Close-up video or clip of the panel surface under angled light, or an electroluminescence image.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as physically defective or non-functional.

risks.risk: Mounting hardware, cables, or connectors may not be included.
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories alongside the panel.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as panel only, with no accessories.

risks.proof: Video clip of the panel producing voltage/current under sunlight or a load with a multimeter reading.

proof_requests: Specification label photo showing wattage and model.
Close-up video of panel surface for defects.
Photo of any included cables, connectors, or mounting hardware.
Video of panel generating power under sunlight.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a solar panel, so it can be priced at its worst case; missing ratings, age, warranty, condition, accessories, and function proof would raise the value.
